newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 28.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 28.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones rose by 14.54 points to 6,007.02. PLDT's ADR fell by $ 3/4 to $58 1/4.
* The peso closed at 26.284 to a U.S.dollar from 26.285.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 2,962.60, down 79.18
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate was unchanged at 11.0625 PCT.

* Analysts said shares of Philippine National Bank were likely to fall further as sentiment on the stock continues to be negative after the bank reported poor nine-months results. "We'll see follow-through selling in the coming week. We're looking at 300 pesos as an initial support level for PNB," Fitzgerald Aclan, research head at Dharmala Securities said.

* Stock brokerage Sapphire Securities said: "From a technical point of view, the market appears to be heading lower until it reaches main support at 2,900 level. The 4-day MA trend of the Phisix shows that it is about to cross over its 9-day MA and a 200-day MA for the first time this year, indicating a continuation of the downtrend.
* Brokerage Dharmala Securities said in a report it expected follow-through selling to continue through most of this week as the market tries to find the bottom of the slide.
"At the moment, investors are advised to stay in the sidelines while the index tests the 2,900 level," Dharmala said.
